n.quote: Exclusion Set 1: Exclude participants who did not complete both writing prompts and all six items evaluating the essay authors. This yields 1,550 participants (n = 699 Author Advised, n = 851 In House).

notes: Original locator p.5 does not align with the located Study 1 result on printed p.629 (third article page). Target matched independently using Study 1 and the replicated subtle-own-death versus TV author-preference contrast. Original OCR spacing in short statistical quote normalized; original paper verified by title and authors in author-uploaded full HTML; retrieved passage cached. Original Table 1 condition n retained separately, rather than treating the generic study total or t degrees of freedom as the two-condition analytic sample. Replication overall locator does not specify a model/exclusion set; selected primary Research Question 1 random-effects analysis with Exclusion Set 1 (Figure 1). The protocol-moderated mixed-effects model separately prints g=0.07, p=.182; those statistics were not combined with this test.
